runtime_notes: Trainers verify recipe["source"]["manifest_path"] against the files it lists. New recipes must bind a source manifest of the package files (paths relative to the manifest), not the packet manifests.
Recipe factory strings such as evaluator_factory and RL reward factories are resolved with importlib; new recipes must name package modules (e.g. sepalith.training.eval.campaign_eval:...).
Entry points run as modules with packages/sepalith/src on PYTHONPATH, e.g. python -m sepalith.training.sft.full_weight_edit_sft.
